einzeiler: Stewart Copeland on The Police, his career, and current news topics.
kurzfassung: Stewart Copeland discusses his background as the founder and drummer of The Police and his work as a composer. The episode also covers news stories including criticism faced by Sen. John Fetterman and an unruly flight incident. Additionally, it looks at research regarding AI and animal communication.
stichpunkte: Stewart Copeland's background and career with The Police
His work composing film and television scores
Criticism facing Sen. John Fetterman regarding official duties
An unruly passenger incident on an American Airlines flight
The use of AI in exploring animal communication and related ethical concerns
beschreibung:
Stewart Copeland is an American drummer best known as the founder and drummer of The Police, one of rock’s most influential bands. He has also composed film and television scores and pursued numerous solo and orchestral projects. For dates to see his spoken word tour live check out stewartcopeland.net.
IN THE NEWS: Sen. John Fetterman faces criticism from fellow Democrats following a Wall Street Journal report alleging that he routinely skipped constituent meetings, committee hearings, and other official duties. An unruly American Airlines passenger is restrained with zip ties and duct tape after a midair disturbance forces a Dallas-to-Newark flight to divert to Baltimore. Plus, researchers explore how AI could help humans decode animal communication, while ethicists raise concerns about animal privacy, consent, and the potential misuse of the technology.
